title: Ruffle Tulle V-Neck Tie-Waist Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Ruffle Tulle V-Neck Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Sheer V-neck maternity photoshoot gown with a tie waist, ruffled tulle cuffs and a sweeping train. 2 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a floaty sheer tulle gown with a V-neck, long sleeves finished in big ruffled cuffs, a sash that ties at the waist above the bump, and ruffled tiers that trail into a sweeping train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 5 days, so please allow about 17-21 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
V-neck, long sheer sleeves with tiered ruffled cuffs, tulle sash tied at the waist, open front with ruffled tiers and a ruffled hem with train.
sheer tulle mesh, chemical fiber blend. The gown is fully sheer, so plan to wear your own slip or lingerie underneath.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust today; the open front and tie waist leave room for the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a fully sheer V-neck tulle maternity gown in robe style with long sheer sleeves ending in big tiered ruffled cuffs, a tulle sash tied in a bow at the waist, an open front with cascading tiers of ruffled tulle down both front edges, and a long skirt with a ruffled hem and a sweeping train
